what: A rolled scroll (axis) drops in from above, stretched vertically, as soon as it loads (1.2s, cubic-bezier(.12,0,.39,0)), flattens horizontally, bounces small twice and stands. Two wisps of smoke bloom and fade over .8s, starting .24s later on both sides. On scroll the panel stays pinned (for one screen height) while the scroll art rolls along, flipping one cell at a time (8 cells steps(7)), and the paper unfolds from 0 to 518px while the axis shifts 5% left (no curve, tied to scroll).

options.frames: Number of frames on the axis image (strip columns), default 8 — steps(frames−1)
options.shift: Distance the axis shifts while unfolding (% of axis width), default −5
options.pin: on (default — panel pinned while it unfolds) · off (when the caller pins it separately)
options.scrub: Delay for following the scroll (sec), default tied immediately (true)
options.drop: on (default) · off — turns off the drop-in on load (for screens that should not make users wait)
options.[data-fx-part=roller]: Axis box — required. Place it at the paper’s left edge, size is set by the one using it
options.[data-fx-part=strip]: (If present) cell strip inside the axis — width is the axis cell count times (800%)
options.[data-fx-part=puff]: (optional) Smoke — the first blooms 15px to the upper left, the second 20px to the upper right, then vanishes
